messages:
ashok: FYI Snyk just flagged CVE-2026-2729 in cryptonative-kms-client (JWT parsing buffer overflow). Affects <=1.4.2. CVSS 8.1, EPSS 0.42. https://snyk.io/vuln/CVE-2026-2729

devsec-bot: automated-scan: found 3 images using cryptonative-kms-client: infra/key-sync:1.4.2, controlplane/config-merger:1.4.2, edge-proxy:1.3.9 (deprecated). PR advisory created: SEC-9874

sylvia: thanks. Is this reachable from untrusted input (eg. public callbacks or partner tokens)?

ashok: short answer: probably via JWTs accepted by the control plane token-exchange endpoint. edge-proxy only uses it for outbound signing but might parse partner JWTs for introspection.

owen: running quick grep on main: `rg "cryptonative-kms-client" -S || true`
Results:
- infra/services/key-sync/main.py: imports cryptonative_kms_client v1.4.2
- controlplane/auth/token_exchange.py: uses KMS JWT verify path (calls client.parse_jwt)
- edge-proxy/src/introspect.rs: vendored binding -> calls into client lib for headers

maria: thanks owen. So controlplane and key-sync are the big ones. Is the controlplane endpoint exposed externally?

owen: controlplane token-exchange is only on private subnet by default, but we accept partner requests via the partner-gateway which forwards tokens. partner-gateway does basic allowlist, but payloads come through.

ashok: exploitability note: overflow triggered by specially-crafted alg header in JWT. So if partner tokens are not sanitized, exploit path exists. We should treat as HIGH and act fast.

sylvia: action suggestions: 1) Patch libs to 1.4.3 where overflow fixed. 2) Temporarily block partner-gateway token route at WAF or add stricter validation. 3) Rotate service principals / keys used by token-exchange. 4) Turn on verbose KMS audit/logging for 30d. 5) Create canary patch in staging + smoke tests.

maria: can we rotate without interrupting running inference nodes? Who has key rotation runbooks?

owen: rotation plan: rotate service principal used by controlplane (not the main customer KMS keys). Steps:
- deploy patched client to staging controlplane (sylvia)
- smoke tests: token-exchange + partner flow (maria)
- if green, deploy to canary subset of controlplane pods (20%)
- rotate SP, update config in infra/key-sync to pick up new creds, verify audit logs emitted

sylvia: I'll take staging patch. ETA 3h to get a build and smoke run.

ashok: who can enable detailed audit logs? we need KMS call records and parsed-jwt audit.

maria: infra team (tagging here) — but infra is out, can we flip on a higher log level from controlplane config without infra changes? it's a config flag: `KMS_AUDIT_LEVEL=verbose` and `PARSE_JWT_AUDIT=true` — shippable via configmap roll.

ashok: good. while sylvia patches, please also drop a firewall rule to block partner-gateway ingress for the token route. temporary mitigation.

oncall-bot: Created Jira ticket SEC-9874: "CVE-2026-2729 cryptonative-kms-client - triage + patch + rotate" and PagerDuty incident PD-3247. Assignees: sylvia, owen. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9874

owen: quick checklist for SEC-9874 in the ticket body I added:
- identify all images referencing vulnerable lib (done)
- patch controlplane and key-sync images + build artifacts
- run the `token-exchange` smoke test suite (tests/token_exchange_smoke.py)
- contrive malformed JWT test to verify overflow fixed (fuzzer harness available in tests/fuzz/jwt_fuzz.py)
- rotate SPs and update config
- enable verbose audit logs for 30d and export to secure-bucket for forensics
- postmortem note and customer impact comms (if partners impacted)

sylvia: small note: edge-proxy using 1.3.9 is not vulnerable path for parsing, but it's using the same binding — I'll include it in builds but deprioritize if token-exchange is mitigated.

maria: do we need RBAC check for who can perform key rotations? might be a good time to validate that only infra-admins + platform-ops have that role. If rotation needed urgently, I can do a quick audit: `gcloud iam roles list --filter="name:rotation*"` and check principals.

ashok: agree. please also add an audit task: list all principals with kms.admin and kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt in prod-projects. We need to revoke any ephemeral tokens used by partner gateway.

nowen: vuln patch PRs in flight: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8123 (upgrade client to 1.4.3 in controlplane), https://github.com/redwood/key-sync/pull/194 (bump to 1.4.3), https://github.com/redwood/edge-proxy/pull/501 (vendor bump). CI currently failing on key-sync integration test, investigating.

sylvia: I'll pick up infra PR review once build artifacts finish. If CI green, I'll kick canary deploy and start rotation runbook.

maria: I'll start the RBAC audit and prepare a short comms draft if partners likely need notice.

ashok: thanks team. Label SEC-9874 as P0 and target full prod patch + rotation within 24h. Keep updates here. :eyes:

oncall-bot: PagerDuty PD-3247 acknowledged by sylvia at 2387654350

sylvia: staging patched and smoke tests passing. Starting canary deploy now.

own: audit logs set to verbose for controlplane and key-sync via configmap roll, exporting to s3://security-forensics/SEC-9874/

maria: RBAC audit done: only infra-admins and platform-ops have rotation rights. no external principals found. I'll hand off rotation to sylvia once canary is green.

sylvia: canary looks good after 30m. rolling to 50% then 100%. I'll post final when done.

ashok: excellent. after full rollout, coordinate key rotation window and log snapshot retention 30d. Add postmortem and add exploit probe results to SEC-9874.

sylvia: full rollout completed at 2387654460. closing loop here, moving to postmortem writeup next. :white_check_mark:
